subject.title: Sync vendored shared skills from openclaw/agent-skills

question: Should behavior-validator, handoff, and session-viewer be promoted into OpenClaw's vendored zero-setup snapshot despite the VISION.md ClawHub-first default?
rationale: Canonical availability proves the skills exist, but repository policy requires a product, security, or ownership reason before OpenClaw assumes bundled maintenance responsibility.

options.title: Split the synchronization
options.body: Refresh agent-transcript and crabbox, let the open maintainer PR own autoreview, and keep the three additions in agent-skills/ClawHub unless separately sponsored.

options.title: Promote all three
options.body: Document the baseline-UX and ownership justification, reconcile autoreview, and then vendor all six trees with exact provenance.

recommendation.title: Split the synchronization
recommendation.body: Refresh agent-transcript and crabbox, let the open maintainer PR own autoreview, and keep the three additions in agent-skills/ClawHub unless separately sponsored.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and most heavily maintained the canonical shared-skill set and authored the current OpenClaw snapshot provenance commit.
